name: ai-divination-skills

tools.name: tarot_draw
tools.description: Draw tarot cards with audited Fisher-Yates shuffle. The host MUST NOT invent the draw. Omit `seed` for real readings; seeded mode is for tests and reproducible demos only.

deck.description: Major arcana only (22 cards) or full 78-card deck.

tools.name: iching_cast
tools.description: Cast an I Ching hexagram. The host MUST NOT invent the cast. Use method=coins, yarrow, or manual (with manual_lines).

manual_lines.description: Required when method=manual. Six comma-separated line values 6/7/8/9.

tools.name: xiaoliuren_cast
tools.description: Cast Xiao Liu Ren (小六壬). The host MUST NOT invent the cast. method=numbers needs month/day/hour, method=time and method=lunar_time take an ISO datetime (lunar_time requires the optional lunar-python dependency).

hour.description: Chinese hour branch index (1-12), not clock hour.

datetime.description: ISO 8601 datetime for method=time or lunar_time.

tools.name: bazi_cast
tools.description: Cast a Bazi (八字 / Four Pillars) chart from a Gregorian birth datetime. The host MUST NOT invent pillars, stems, branches, or wuxing. Requires the optional lunar-python dependency.

datetime.description: Gregorian ISO 8601 birth datetime, e.g. 1990-05-20T14:30:00. The hour pillar requires an exact birth time.

tools.name: interpretation_template
tools.description: Return the interpretation template (shared + per-skill) that the host should follow before writing an interpretation.

instructions: This server exposes audited divination scripts. Never invent a draw or cast. Run a tool, then interpret the JSON output using interpretation_template(skill=...).
